basic_info.description: This rarely available 1BD/1BA residence offers  unobstructed East-facing views of the Bay and Bay Bridge and the building's pool. Enjoy an oversized private terrace, perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation. Inside, the home features beautiful wood floors throughout and a gourmet kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and ample cabinet space. The open-concept living and dining area is flooded with natural light from floor-to-ceiling double-pane windows.  The spacious primary suite offers direct access to the terrace and a spa-like upgraded bathroom, making it the perfect retreat. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, one-car parking, and a dedicated storage unit.  88 King is a full-service luxury condo building located across the street from the South Beach Marina. The building offers luxurious resort-style amenities, including a heated outdoor pool and spa, a sun deck with a full BBQ, a fire pit, and heat lamps. Residents also enjoy a private fitness center, conference room, business center, and entertainment room. The location is prime: located just a block from the Embarcadero waterfront, Oracle Park and a short walk to the Ferry Building, Chase Center, entertainment & restaurants.
